exposure: Presence or absence of Post Spinal Anesthesia Hypotension (PSAH)
outcome: Predictive value of IVCCI and IJVCI for PSAH
cohort: 76 pregnant females scheduled for elective cesarean section
finding: Both IVCCI and IJVCI were found to be effective predictors of PSAH, with IVCCI demonstrating slightly better specificity and overall accuracy.
